stages.headline: An ellipse is the locus of points whose distances to two fixed points F₁, F₂ (the foci) have a constant sum.
stages.headlineEnglish: An ellipse is the locus of points whose distances to two fixed points F₁, F₂ (the foci) have a constant sum.

stages.headline: To draw an ellipse, fix a string's ends at the foci and move a pencil keeping the string tight.
stages.headlineEnglish: To draw an ellipse, fix a string's ends at the foci and move a pencil keeping the string tight.

stages.headline: Ellipses occur in nature: planetary orbits are ellipses with the Sun at one focus.
stages.headlineEnglish: Ellipses occur in nature: planetary orbits are ellipses with the Sun at one focus.

stages.headline: What is constant for points of an ellipse?
stages.headlineEnglish: What is constant for points of an ellipse?

choices: the difference of the distances to the foci
the sum of the distances to the foci
